title: 第17章 仙境 诗句第18章 你可是亲传啊
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
在与众位内门弟子告别后，龙涛并没有着急走人，他当然不能走，不然别说偷窥任务了，连浴室外的签到任务都没法交差。
“龙师弟，还不走吗？”
那熟悉又温润如玉的声音从身后传来，转头一看...正是儒雅温和的完美师兄周师兄，龙涛对这人已经有了个大概的印象，所以完全没有深交的打算，只是随意应付道，
“好不容易来一趟，被这漱月峰仙境迷了眼，还想多看几眼，就先厚脸皮的多呆一会儿吧，等她们赶人时再走。”
“哈哈，人之常情，我当年初入内门时，亦是如此。”
周师兄笑容和煦，仿佛真的在追忆往昔，但话锋随即一转，“不过这漱月峰上的女人可都不好对付，刚才朱师姐给你的差事，恐怕会很辛苦啊。”
龙涛脸上赶紧适时地露出惶恐和懊悔。
“唉...师弟我也知道，真要每天都这么事无巨细的记录肯定吃不消，今天也是有些过于想表现自己了，到时候肯定还是要倚赖周师兄。”
龙涛这番话语以及那谦卑到谄媚的样子，让周师兄也是满意的点了点头，便不再多言，转身走向山门的方向。
......
就在周师兄走后没多一会儿，一个熟悉的身影也出现在了门口，
“龙师兄！”
一个带着少年人特有雀跃的声音响起。
龙涛猛地转头，看到门口那张熟悉的脸庞时，紧绷的嘴角终于露出如释重负的笑意，破局的钥匙，总算来了！
“南师弟！”
他快步迎上，语气里带着恰到好处的欣喜，“可算等到你了！”
眼前的南宇辰，就像前世刚熬完晚自习冲出来的高中生。
脸上带着明显的疲惫，却又有着“终于下课可以撒欢”
的纯粹兴奋。
“龙师兄，你真来了啊，现在天色还亮，我带你去逛逛吧。”

看着少年那开心的样子，龙涛心里却打起了十二分精神，这小子是自己这次系统任务最大也是唯一的破局点，从现在开始...和他的每一句话、甚至每一个动作都不能出纰漏。
不仅需要走一步看一步，还要斟酌自己的每句话。
首要目标：赖在漱月峰过夜！
否则别说偷窥，连去浴室门口打卡都是痴心妄想。
“好啊，今天忙了一天，也没办法出去，师兄我就厚着脸皮跟你走两圈吧。”
有着这位亲传弟子带路，龙涛终于不用那么小心翼翼的了，通过云路很快来到漱月峰的中部。
当眼前的景象豁然开朗时，饶是龙涛心中有着千斤重担，也忍不住呼吸一窒，这哪里还是人间？分明是神仙用灵石硬生生砸出来的天宫。
头顶，是一片蓝紫色的人造天幕。
真正的太阳完全被遮住，取而代之的，是一轮悬于半空、散发着清冷柔和光晕的...假月亮！
那月亮不知是何等天材地宝炼成，通体温润，皎洁无瑕，比真月更圆、更亮、更近在咫尺，仿佛伸手就能触碰。
假月光辉之下，是一片浩瀚无垠的平湖！
湖水并非凡水，而是呈现出一种梦幻般的、流动的翡翠色泽，波光粼粼，倒映着天上的假月星辰。
湖面上，星罗棋布着大大小小的岛屿，如同天神随手洒落的棋子，岛上琼楼玉宇、奇花异草随处可见。
content_en:
After saying goodbye to all the inner disciples, Long Tao was not in a hurry to leave. Of course he couldn't leave, otherwise he wouldn't be able to complete the peeping mission, and even the sign-in mission outside the bathroom.
"Junior Brother Long, aren't you leaving yet?"
The familiar and gentle voice came from behind. He turned around and saw...it was none other than the elegant, gentle and perfect senior brother Zhou. Long Tao already had a rough impression of this person, so he had no intention of getting close to each other and just casually said,
"It's not easy to come here. I'm fascinated by this Shuyue Peak Wonderland. If you still want to see a few more times, just be shameless and stay for a while, and then leave when they drive people away."
"Haha, it's human nature. It was the same when I first entered the inner sect."
Senior Brother Zhou smiled warmly, as if he was really reminiscing about the past, but the conversation immediately changed, "But the women on Shuyue Peak are not easy to deal with. The errand that Senior Sister Zhu gave you just now will probably be very hard."
Long Tao's face immediately showed fear and regret.
"Sigh... Junior Brother, I also know that it would be too much to keep such detailed records every day. Today I also wanted to express myself a little too much. I will definitely have to rely on Senior Brother Zhou then."
Long Tao's words and his humble and flattering look made Senior Brother Zhou nod his head with satisfaction. He said no more and turned towards the mountain gate.
...
Not long after Senior Brother Zhou left, a familiar figure appeared at the door.
"Senior Brother Long!"
A voice with the characteristic excitement of a young man sounded.
Long Tao turned his head suddenly, and when he saw the familiar face at the door, a relieved smile finally appeared on the corners of his tight mouth. The key to breaking the situation was finally here!
"Junior Brother Nan!"
He hurried up to meet him, with just the right amount of joy in his voice, "I've been waiting for you!"
The Nan Yuchen in front of him looked like a high school student who had just finished his evening self-study in his previous life.
There is obvious fatigue on his face, but he also has the feeling of "I can finally have fun after class."
of pure excitement.
"Senior Brother Long, you're really here. It's still bright now. I'll take you for a walk."
Seeing the young man's happy expression, Long Tao became more energetic. This boy was his biggest and only breaking point in this system mission. From now on... there would be no mistakes in his every word or even action.
Not only do you need to watch every step you take, but you also need to consider every word you say.
The primary goal: Lai spend the night at Sowol Peak!
Otherwise, let alone peeping, even checking in at the bathroom door would be wishful thinking.
"Okay, I've been busy all day and can't go out. Senior brother, I'll just walk around with you shamelessly."
With this direct disciple leading the way, Long Tao finally no longer had to be so cautious and quickly reached the middle of Shuyue Peak through the Cloud Road.
When the scene in front of him suddenly became clear, even though Long Tao was carrying a heavy burden in his heart, he couldn't help but feel suffocated. Where is this human world? It was clearly a heavenly palace that the gods had smashed out with spiritual stones.
Above the head is a blue-purple artificial sky.
The real sun was completely covered, replaced by a... fake moon hanging in the sky, emitting a cool and soft halo!
The moon is made of countless treasures from heaven and earth. It is moist, bright and flawless. It is rounder, brighter and closer than the real moon, as if you can reach out and touch it.
Under the light of the false moon, there is a vast flat lake!
The lake water is not ordinary water, but presents a dreamlike, flowing emerald color, sparkling, reflecting the false moon and stars in the sky.
On the lake, islands of various sizes are dotted like chess pieces randomly scattered by the gods. On the islands, beautiful buildings, jade buildings, and exotic flowers and plants can be seen everywhere.
